name: Yellow birch veneer, grain along the panel's width (for plywood layers)
note: Wood Handbook chapter 5: yellow birch at 12 % moisture, bending modulus 13,900 MPa (Table 5-3a) raised 10 % to E_L; E_T/E_L 0.050, G_LR/E_L 0.074, G_LT/E_L 0.068, G_RT/E_L 0.017 (Table 5-1); mu_LT 0.451 (Table 5-2); density from specific gravity 0.62 times 1.12. Plywood is stacked from this veneer with alternate layers turned 90 degrees; the glue is left out.

source.title: USDA Forest Products Laboratory, Wood Handbook (FPL-GTR-190), chapter 5, Mechanical Properties of Wood (copy by CED Engineering)
